title: Kumar NDE 3941
content: Due to serious complications of childbirth I was rushed for life-saving surgery. While I was rushed to surgery, I was telling the doctor about things that were going to happen next and they did happen. After the surgery, my doctor explained that I had reached the stage of heightened awareness and so was being able to tell what was going to happen next. At one point during the surgery, I remember having no air inside me. I believe that was the time when my lungs had collapsed (as told by the doctor later). They had lost me for about eleven seconds. At this time, I remember very clearly, what I felt was something like someone wanting to place some blocks on me - like a jigsaw puzzle - but they didn't know where to fix it. I knew and wanted to let them know. I was screaming to tell but they could not hear me. I lifted my arm but suddenly realized my arm was in two places on the operation table and trying to reach the doctor. At that point, I gave up but strangely, I was not at all sad. I accepted it almost, lay back feeling satisfied with a feeling of a lot of peace and calm around me. I felt happy that the doctors had failed to fit the puzzle piece. Then suddenly I felt a gush of cold air filling my body which may have been the ventilator starting. I woke up the next day.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt like "someone wanting to place some blocks on me - like a jigsaw puzzle"; tried to tell them; realized her arm was "in two places"; then "a lot of peace and calm" and acceptance; later "a gush of cold air filling my body" (ventilator starting).

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt "a gush of cold air filling my body" (interpreted as ventilator starting), then woke up the next day.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Reported predicting what would happen next during rush to surgery; 'jigsaw puzzle' sensation; peace/calm; cold air/ventilator and return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Precognitive statements occurred before the OBE-like episode; no tunnel/arrival/life review described; return linked to ventilator sensation.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Felt like others were trying to fit 'blocks' like a jigsaw puzzle onto her body but didn't know where; she knew and tried to tell them; perceived her arm 'in two places' (on the table and reaching toward the doctor).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "someone wanting to place some blocks on me - like a jigsaw puzzle - but they didn't know where to fix it"; "I lifted my arm but suddenly realized my arm was in two places"; "a lot of peace and calm around me"; "a gush of cold air filling my body".
